articles.title: Stock futures rise as traders digest Big Tech earnings and hope to recover from Fed Day sell-off: Live updates - CNBC
articles.description: Investors were digesting megacap tech earnings and the Federal Reserve's decision to hold rates steady.
articles.content: U.S. equity futures rose early Thursday as investors digested the latest Big Tech earnings, the Federal Reserve's decision to hold rates steady, and the resumption of hostilities in the Middle East. … [+3256 chars]
